runs.title: First Aging Clocks Catalog research foundation

runs.title: Reliability, portability and meaningful change
runs.summary: Interpret a change only after fixing the clock version, assay pipeline, score unit, repeatability and decision threshold.

runs.title: Intervention evidence and six-clock trial audit
runs.summary: The six-clock rentosertib analysis has a reported patient-label randomization check, but its selected 42-person cohort cannot establish aging-specific efficacy.

runs.title: Do aging clocks add useful information?
runs.summary: Keep the same base information, eligible participants, outcome and horizon when testing whether another aging clock adds value.
